cards.title: London open fade on EURUSD
cards.summary: Sell a failed break of the Asian high in the first London hour, stop five pips above the wick.
cards.entry: Sell at the next 15-minute candle open after price breaks the Asian high in the first London hour and closes back inside the range.
cards.exit: Take profit around the middle of the Asian range.

parameters.name: stop
parameters.value: five pips above the breakout wick
